mirror.note: Since 2026-06-20 all repos migrated to GitHub, origin=GitHub; Gitee is only the infra-deploy manifest repo and a backup mirror.

control-tower.description: openIndu independent control layer: maintains routing info, Agent principles, agent definitions; directs sub-repo template/script/Agent-prompt updates.

openIndu-website.description: Aggregate dev repo: submodule-aggregates backend + admin + portal + studio; docker-compose local stack; RULE 11 steps 4+5 entry is this repo's own /release command (not the plugin's /build).

production_db.note: RULE 10 production-SQL protection target. Host, port, database and credentials are all injected via vault or env — never committed to this repo.

openIndu-backend.description: FastAPI Web API (8004) + MCP Server (8005); depends on PostgreSQL + Milvus + Aliyun OSS.

openIndu-studio.release_flow: library — it IS the 4th submodule of openIndu-website (confirmed 2026-08-05 against .gitmodules), but produces no container image and has no manifest in infra-deploy, so RULE 11 ends at the aggregate submodule-pointer PR
openIndu-studio.description: AI-assisted PLC/HMI program development toolchain: electrical-module survey, circuit design, BOM generation, IO-address planning through PLC/HMI programming; includes RAG knowledge base and MCP tools. Python 99%. GitHub is the authoritative source (confirmed 2026-08-04); Gitee is mirror only — if a local clone points at Gitee, switch origin.

openIndu-platform.release_flow: independent — not in the openIndu-website submodule aggregate; image build and deploy per its own pipeline

pending_rewrite.note: Python→Rust rewrite (Modbus driver / edge alarm / data transform). Rust file count on main is 0; the rust role covers this in-flight work.

openIndu-platform.description: Industrial-internet platform (IIoT base): device access, data pipeline, application runtime (platform layer). Long-term moat. Polyglot monorepo — a single type can't express its stack; dispatch must descend to module granularity.

openindu-station.description: Self-developed station app (described as openindu-motor): 8 .csproj, 180 .cs. Includes motion control, vision, scan, dispensing and laser-cutting apps. The only repo in the org with a standalone test project (Verify).

openIndu-controller.release_flow: independent — not in the openIndu-website submodule aggregate; edge deploy differs from cluster
openIndu-controller.description: Edge controller, connecting real industrial devices (collect/dispatch); the hands and feet of the industrial loop (edge layer). 3 .csproj, 110 .cs.

divergence.patch_scope: plc4net/ entirely (40 .cs / 6 .csproj / 1 .sln / 1 .props) + 1 .NET CI workflow; Java / Go / Ruby / C untouched.
divergence.patch_nature: net452→net8.0 migration, SPI3 driver runtime implementation, API alignment (Field→Tag), bit codec and ReadBuffer/WriteBuffer fixes, plus 929 lines of new tests.

plc4x.description: Fork of Apache PLC4X (industrial-protocol adapter). The org's largest code body (~197 MB): Java 73% / Go 8% / Ruby 7% / C# 4% / C 3%. Local patches are 100% in plc4net/ (the .NET subproject), owned by the station-control role — upstream Java/Go/Ruby code is never modified and needs no corresponding language role. Behind upstream by 18 commits; periodic rebase required.

openplc-runtime.description: Fork of OpenPLC Runtime v4. Python 37% / C 35% / C++ 25%. Zero local changes — pure mirror, only 41 commits behind upstream. Needs no delivery role; just a sync strategy: periodic fast-forward, or archive once no longer needed.

.github.description: Org-level GitHub config (profile / issue templates). No business code; no agent assigned.

community.description: Community governance docs. No business code; no agent assigned.

infra-deploy.description: K8s manifest sole home (Deployment/Service/ConfigMap/Secret/Ingress). The openIndu-website/ subdir corresponds to this platform. PR title/body in English (RULE 9).
